items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: I had some brilliant, brilliant men in that band. It was a complacent, Ross Dawg.

ctx.x: Well, you guys' song were pretty dark in the band.

Oh, yeah, really. Well, Nick was what you call real black Nick was. But, like I say, you know, color doesn't play too much of a part in the world. I thought it shouldn't because I had some brilliant, brilliant men in that band. It was a complacent, Ross Dawg.
